name: Order-block retest
hypothesis: After a bullish displacement bar (body > 1.5 ATR, new 10-bar high) that follows a bearish candle, buy the first retest 3-30 bars later that touches that candle's high and closes above it; stop 0.1 ATR under its low; target 2R.
